Join us for a playful yoga class for our littlest yogis — yoga, partner poses, games & a craft to help our four-legged friends!

About this Event

The Yoga Club : Old Brooklyn Oct 24thCommunity Helpers: A Kids Yoga Class (Ages 4-6) at Kindrid Kava

Ready to stretch, breathe, and have fun? Join The Yoga Club in Old Brooklyn on October 24th for a joyful, in-person session made just for our littlest yogis. Whether it's their first class or they're already yoga pros, this is a chance to move, connect, and find their flow.

Community Helpers is a playful yoga class for our littlest yogis, part of The Yoga Club City Tour. We'll talk about the different community helpers we see every day, from teachers to firefighters to veterinarians, and explore the many ways kids can be helpers too. We'll move like our favorite helpers, play partner games, and make craft for a local dog shelter.
Date & Location: Saturday, October 24 | Kindrid Kava (Old Brooklyn)
Ages: 4-6 | 45 minutes
What kids will learn: Simple breathing tools and mindfulness practices they can use anywhere to stay calm, focused, and confident, plus how everyone, including kids, can help their community.
What kids will do:
Start with breathwork and a gentle yoga warm-upTalk together about community helpers we see every dayMove through fun yoga poses and partner gamesMake a craft to help our four-legged friends at a local dog shelterWind down with a mindfulness activity and relaxationWhat to bring: Comfy clothes and a water bottle. Mats and all materials are provided.
